R0053.title: Malicious User Harassment
R0053.definition: A seller uses improper means to continuously and intentionally harass users.
R0053.description: May include but is not limited to frequent solicitation, false advertising, threats, intimidation, and persistent harassing messages. More severe cases include mailing razor blades or cash-on-delivery packages to users. Many cases arise from transaction disputes, such as coercing users to retract negative reviews or retaliating against users who file complaints.
R0053.influence: Users suffer sustained harassment, personal threats, or psychological harm, disrupting their daily life and transaction order and leading to complaints, negative reviews, and user churn; merchants face platform penalties such as point deductions, traffic restrictions, or store closure, and may incur administrative or even criminal liability.

references.title: How Does Taobao Determine Buyer Harassment? What Are the Penalties?

observables: A single seller sends a large volume of in-platform messages or calls to the same buyer within a short window, at mechanical frequency
Retaliatory shipments (e.g., razor blades, cash-on-delivery packages) appear immediately after a buyer files a complaint or negative review
Seller contact details are repeatedly used for persistent outreach outside transaction disputes, harassing the same buyer across channels
After-sales tickets contain written records of coerced review retraction, threats, or intimidation
